name: Z-End
source:
A zombie apocalypse. The world as we know it is gone. You take the role of a survivor who's been sent by your community to look for new members.

On your way, you meet up with the mysterious Faye. What secrets is this mysterious character hiding? Will you be able to convince her to join the community? Will you be able to overcome the danger of this dying world?

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/582610/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
僵尸启示录。我们所知道的世界已经消失了。你扮演一名幸存者的角色，他被你的社区派去寻找新成员。

在途中，你遇到了神秘的费伊。这个神秘人物到底隐藏着什么秘密？你能说服她加入社区吗？你能克服这个垂死世界的危险吗？

[来自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/582610/]Steam[/url]]
